output.english_question: Under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, would it be compliant to only mention the bank’s online schedule of penal charges in the sanction letter and loan documents?
sub_queries: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions mention penal charges sanction letter loan documents online schedule
penal charges disclosure requirements sanction letter loan agreement online schedule RBI
compliance RCDC directions penal charges disclosure upfront borrowers
premises: The bank would disclose penal charges only by referring to (and not reproducing) an online schedule within the sanction letter and loan documents.
